# Post Clarity

> Post Clarity is Kansas City's premier professional cover band, delivering high-energy live performances for corporate events, weddings, festivals, and private parties. Based in Kansas City, MO.

Post Clarity specializes in pop, punk, pop-punk, emo, and 2000s-era hits. The band is available for booking throughout the Kansas City metro area and beyond.
